additional_info.subject: Reported from the customer
additional_info.body: After updating the firmware from Ver4 to Ver6, full power no longer seems to be available. It is a Sicharge D160 lowflex. If a truck is plugged in, it gets full power for a short time, after about 15 minutes the power reduces to 120 kW, then it drops steadily to 20 kW - even the truck has a SoC of << 80%. The photo from January 20th shows a Volvo truck alone, which is charged with 20 kW. Before the update, the full power of 160 kW was available. Today there were two Iveco trucks at the sicharge with 80 + 20 kW ... instead of 80 kW + 80 kW The charging station with full power is necessary for our logistics.

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0401334-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R6 170001953] Charger is delivering less power CRM:00641000970
additional_info.body:
Hi Mr Malokar,
yesterday we had the possibility to run different scenarios on this Sicharger D160. After the firmware update V4 to V6 this limitation occurs nearly every time. We tried it with different trucks on different times. During plug in, full power of 160kw is delivered. After a period of 5 or 10 minutes it reduced to apr. 100 kW, and some minutes later only 20 kW are delivered … until the end of laoding.  At our AC Wallbox we can load with 22 kW, too.
J
21.01.2025
11h56 OAL VM 69 – Volvo Truck at SoC 77% …only 19 kW … see Volvo App   (loading period 11:26 – 12:05 for 26,4 kWh)
…unknown Date: 14h26 OAL VM 49 – Volvo Truck at SoC 70% …only 19 kW .. see driver video
27.01.2025  17h00
we try it with Iveco Truck at SoC of 32%, back from tour, 350 kW max Loading power on Sicharge D160 outlet 1. Only This truck was loading.
17h06    plugin…160 kW
17h15   reduced to 99 kW
17h15    if you tap on Sicharge screensaver, power increases from 99 kW to 140 kW … only for short time. Than its reducing back to 99 kW. Two times we could repeat this issue. Unfortunately not for a third time, as the video was running.
…because of the raining day, we don’t want wait longer to make a picture with 20 kW.
17h31    we changed to D300 (MP R6 / 17000 2000) outlet 1 => 267 kW (…why we don’t get 300 kW, we still don’t know. We will create a new ticket, when we have suitable pictures on this and other sicharges)
Due to different trucks, mail carbon copy is a little bit longer.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401334-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R6 170001953] Charger is delivering less power CRM:00641000970
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0401334 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
While analyzing the logs we saw that there is communication issue with power converter 3, which also affects other converters in that group resulting in 20kW power while charging.
Please perform the following steps to find the root cause of the issue:
Remove power converter
2102312VGQLUN9000221SA002200000200FW and check the charging, whether power is being reduced or not.
If not, check the CAN communication cable for this converter.
If yes, exchange this converter with any other converter on outlet 1, and check the charging process,
Check other power converter in the same group to see whether they are working fine or not.
Issue can be at converter and communication cable, need to check each converter before deciding to replace it.
Also, once site intervention is complete, please update the note on ISP with following information:
Defective part name/MLFB
Component serial number
Logs with marked error (CSV format preferred) - Attached in notes
Active error flags before replacement
Device-specific error code - E17
Outcome of wiring checkup
Commissioning checklist
Commissioning date
Field service report
Date of failure
Converter position and group
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
May be
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Yes
Performance monitoring by RC
Yes
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "

".
Thank you.
